assertions.name: c_swap_leaves_generator_invariant
assertions.source: For every nucleon pair (F1,F2) in {p,n,pbar,nbar}^2 and both 2-dim Hecke representations at q0, the color-tube weighted generator with uniform W and the stated eps rule satisfies sigma^(CF1,CF2) = sigma^(F1,F2) to < 1e-45 elementwise (65-dps compute). Matches the Lean derivation: eps is C-invariant (chiralitySign_conj_invariant, sorry-free) and the uniform W is constant; the conjectural class field weight_conj_invariant asserts the same for the open Bring-derived W.

assertions.name: eps_and_w_tables_c_invariant
assertions.source: Exact check over all 16 nucleon pairs x 9 color pairs (144 cells per table): eps(c1,c2,CF1,CF2) == eps(c1,c2,F1,F2) and W(c1,c2,CF1,CF2) == W(c1,c2,F1,F2).

description: Open-R&D prototype of conj:c-from-color-flavor-swap (D6): verifies at the substrate q0 (50 dps) that the flavor-conjugation involution C (u<->ubar, d<->dbar per color sheet) leaves the color-tube weighted inter-nucleon Hecke generator sigma^(F1,F2) = sum W_{c1c2} sigma^{eps(c1,c2,F1,F2)} invariant, for all 16 nucleon pairs from {p,n,pbar,nbar} in two 2-dim Hecke representations (diagonal eigenvalue model and a non-diagonal conjugate). Runs the UNIFORM projection W=1/9 (the only W realisation today; the Bring-derived closed form is open — open question 1 of conj:inter-nucleon-channel-color-tube) with the block's stated eps rule, so this is the numeric cross-check of the Lean derivation (CFromColorFlavorSwap.lean: chiralitySign_conj_invariant + signedWeightSum_conj_invariant), not an independent test of the conjectural W. Exact eps/W table invariance also checked (144 cells each). No fit, parameter-free.
